Use case: stylized-concept. Make a landscape 2x2 reference sheet for the Tidekin procedural island study. Reference input is the original concept sheet, use its luminous tropical color, warm limestone, vibrant foliage and clean turquoise water. Not an edit target. TWO distinct candidate permutations of ONE biome: left column variation 1, right column variation 2. Top panels show near-water gameplay approach at camera height 7m, no hero character, tiny timber raft for scale only. Bottom panels show the corresponding SAME island from a reverse elevated view, proving it is a freestanding island attractive from the back. All-around composition with AT LEAST THREE broad navigable water gaps distributed around island, no theatrical closed back wall, no one-entrance corridor. Show varied low boulders transitioning through curved sand shelves and greenery to limestone heights. Rich yet plausible stylized 3D game art, no UI, no buildings, no arch anywhere, avoid perfectly cylindrical rocks, avoid uniform rows. Island silhouette, beach transitions, appropriate diverse foliage and readable shallow water gradient are priorities. Text footer exactly 'GENERATED REFERENCE — NOT RUNNING CODE'.
BIOME: LAGOON. Variation 1: broad shallow aquamarine lagoon embraced by three unequal curved low sandy islands, one tall asymmetric limestone cluster, palms and coastal broadleaf shrubs. Variation 2: lagoon with four irregular sandy islands, taller twin limestone outcrops separated by water, scattered skerries. Both have open water gaps on multiple sides, absolutely no arch or bridge. Titles 'A1 — Open turquoise lagoon' and 'A2 — Broken limestone lagoon'.
